FinalMobile_image118_FDI42_modules_HiRes: Module-specific attributions from the final DENT-STRIDE-Mobile EMA (seed 2, K=4, temperature 0.50). All columns within a row use the same trained model, image and native ordinary query. Predictions are orange; teal dashed boxes are ground truth. Detection CAM uses the finest encoder output, CMFA CAM uses the finer top-down fusion output, and HOOA edge CAM uses the high-pass branch tensor. These three explain the same reference-FDI detection logit. Prototype CAM explains the actual auxiliary prototype class score at the finest encoder output. Each positive map is normalized by its own full-image maximum before cropping, with bilinear interpolation for display. These maps show relative spatial attribution, not comparable contribution strength across modules. Prototype inference fusion weight is zero. Gradients follow differentiable paths but do not traverse detached top-k content initialization. This is a mechanism illustration, not a comparison between independently retrained models; efficacy requires the accompanying controlled ablations. The method is positive elementwise gradient-times-activation (HiResCAM form). Cases: (a) image 118, FDI 42.
